title: Psalm 22
firstLine: My God, my God, O why hast Thou forsaken me? O why art Thou so far from giving help and from my groaning cry?

tuneRef.title: Must Jesus Bear the Cross Alone

lines: My God, my God, O why hast Thou forsaken me? O why art Thou so far from giving help and from my groaning cry?
All those who look on me will laugh and cast reproach at me. Their mouths they open wide; they wag their heads in mockery.
For lo the dogs encompass me! On every side they stand, these men of wicked cruelty; they pierce my feet and hands.
My bones are plain for me to number, men look on me and stare. My clothes among themselves divide, and gamble for their share.
Now hurry, O my Strength to help! O be not far, O Lord! But snatch my soul from raging dogs, and spare it from the sword!
